nameOrigin: a species of reptile; ‘ekans’ spelled backwards is ‘snake’

pokedexEntries.rb: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

pokedexEntries.ye: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

pokedexEntries.go: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

pokedexEntries.si: It always hides in grass. When first born, it has no poison, so its bite is painful, but harmless.

pokedexEntries.cr: It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.

pokedexEntries.rs: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.

pokedexEntries.fr: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.lg: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

pokedexEntries.em: An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

pokedexEntries.hg: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

pokedexEntries.ss: It always hides in grass. When first born, it has no poison, so its bite is painful, but harmless.

pokedexEntries.us: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

pokedexEntries.um: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.
